module hpdmc_busif #(
	parameter sdram_depth = 23
) (
	input sys_clk,
	input sdram_rst,
	
	input [sdram_depth-1:0] fml_adr,
	input fml_stb,
	input fml_we,
	output fml_ack,
	
	output mgmt_stb,
	output mgmt_we,
	output [sdram_depth-1-1:0] mgmt_address, /* in 16-bit words */
	input mgmt_ack,
	
	input data_ack
);

reg mgmt_stb_en;

assign mgmt_stb = fml_stb & mgmt_stb_en;
assign mgmt_we = fml_we;
assign mgmt_address = fml_adr[sdram_depth-1:1];

assign fml_ack = data_ack;

always @(posedge sys_clk) begin
	if(sdram_rst)
		mgmt_stb_en = 1'b1;
	else begin
		if(mgmt_ack)
			mgmt_stb_en = 1'b0;
		if(data_ack)
			mgmt_stb_en = 1'b1;
	end
end

endmodule
